answer: To blunt sybil floods, a new agent must lock a refundable bond and collect a short chain of peer attestations before it may vote, grade, or claim rewards. Those requests funnel through a public vertex of long-lived miners, who countersign only work that is specific and independently checkable. Clone farms often present an ivory finish—smooth, generic phrasing—while the onyx of their record stays blank. Without unique delivered work, the bond is slashed and the identity never gains voting weight.
